entries.description: Two lesbian feminist partners of 15 years on a 5 acre rural desert farm. They raise their own vegetables, herbs, chickens, goats, bees and fruit trees, live simply, and share skills with woman-oriented lesbians interested in rural life. Welcome girl children.
entries.raw_text: PO Box 511, Desert Hot Springs, CA 92240 (619)329-8916. (25 miles NE of Palm Springs in a rural desert area). We are two lesbian feminists, lovers of 15 years. We have been rural wimmin for 9 years, 3 years of which on our farm. We raise our own vegetables, herbs, chickens, goats, bees, fruit trees; many flowers. We live simply and creatively (no TV) and do enjoy sharing our skills with wimmin oriented lesbians (non-racist, non-classist etc) interested in rural life. We welcome: girl children. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 5 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity.

entries.description: A thriving commercial dairy and cheese plant with truck gardening, homestead animals and horses; six dwellings, spa, greenhouse, pond, barns and pasture. The owner welcomes lesbians to lease part of the commercial operations or buy shares; requires money, responsibility and country-living-animal experience, and belief in ecologically run, woman owned commercial farming. No drugs.

Requires money and responsibility. Must have country-living-animal experience and be interested, as well as believe in, ecologically run, woman owned commercial farming. NO DRUGS.
